principle_violations.reason: The Square and Circle classes violate the Liskov Substitution Principle because they implement an unfeasible method 'volume' by raising a NotImplementedError, which cannot be easily substituted in client code expecting all Shape derivatives to properly implement 'volume.'
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the Shape class to better differentiate between 2D and 3D shapes, using separate 2D and 3D shape interfaces. Alternatively, introduce an optional capability pattern for volume computation.
